results.label: token read failure preserves status and clears variable
results.command:
export DOTNET_ROOT="$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$(command -v dotnet)")")" MCPCLI_HOME="$HOME/hexalith-operator/home"
(read -rsp 'Token: ' token && echo && "$HOME/hexalith-operator/tools/hexalith" config profile add operator --url http://127.0.0.1:18170 --token "$token"; mcpcli_token_status=$?; unset token; exit "$mcpcli_token_status")

mcpcli_failure_status=$?
[ "${token+x}" != x ] || exit 99
exit "$mcpcli_failure_status"
